mapper.sql: h.id, h.house_no, h.title, h.host_id, h.category_id, h.cover_img, h.province, h.city, h.district, h.address, h.price, h.area, h.bedroom, h.living_room, h.bathroom, h.bed_count, h.max_guest, h.floor_desc, h.facilities, h.description, h.score, h.view_count, h.order_count, h.status, h.audit_remark, h.created_by, h.creation_date, h.modify_by, h.modify_date
mapper.select: SELECT , c.category_name, u.real_name AS host_name, u.phone AS host_phone, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review rv WHERE rv.house_id = h.id AND rv.status = 1) AS review_count FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_category c ON h.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON h.host_id = u.id WHERE h.id = #{id}

SELECT , c.category_name, u.real_name AS host_name FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_category c ON h.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON h.host_id = u.id WHERE h.status = 1 ORDER BY h.order_count DESC, h.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , c.category_name, u.real_name AS host_name FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_category c ON h.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON h.host_id = u.id WHERE h.status = 1 ORDER BY h.creation_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , c.category_name, u.real_name AS host_name FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_category c ON h.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON h.host_id = u.id WHERE h.host_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY h.creation_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (house_no, title, host_id, category_id, cover_img, province, city, district, address, price, area, bedroom, living_room, bathroom, bed_count, max_guest, floor_desc, facilities, description, score, view_count, order_count, status, audit_remark, created_by, creation_date) VALUES (#{houseNo}, #{title}, #{hostId}, #{categoryId}, #{coverImg}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{price}, #{area}, #{bedroom}, #{livingRoom}, #{bathroom}, #{bedCount}, #{maxGuest}, #{floorDesc}, #{facilities}, #{description}, #{score}, #{viewCount}, #{orderCount}, #{status}, #{auditRemark}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE house SET status = #{status}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, modify_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE house SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE house SET order_count = order_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM house WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT c.category_name AS name, COUNT(h.id) AS value FROM house_category c LEFT JOIN house h ON c.id = h.category_id AND h.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT h.city AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM house h WHERE h.status = 1 GROUP BY h.city ORDER BY value DESC, h.city ASC LIMIT #{limit}
